entries.title: Hack #3 — LLM-as-parser, self-healing ingestion
entries.summary: ### Hack #3 — LLM-as-parser, self-healing ingestion Every ingest job is: fetch (or read email) → hand raw HTML/text to a cheap model with a strict JSON schema → validate with Pydantic → insert. When a site changes layout, nothing breaks — the model reads the new layout.
